CustosCalculator.description: The absolute path of the Calculator's binary, pcalc, on this wiki's server. Empty: no call runs (every call is refused). Set by the Operator in LocalSettings.php; no default path.

CustosBuild.description: The Calculator this wiki expects: its version (what `pcalc version` prints) and the SHA-256 digest of its binary, 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Checked before every call, after the binary's residence (under /opt or /usr, root's, writable by no other user; else UNSAFE RESIDENCE); a binary whose digest differs is refused (DIGEST MISMATCH). Empty: no call runs.

CustosUwcRoot.description: The root under which each UWC's pages live, <root>/<prefix>/....

CustosDeclRoot.description: The root under which the pages the Declarer declares live.

CustosPollAfter.description: The seconds an agent waits before it polls a ticket again: the 202 of every op that writes a ticket and POLL of a ticket not yet DONE answer it as poll_after, a constant (no Calculator in a web request); the landing job's waits (LOCK HELD, PAGE FAULT, an ADMISSION refusal without the governor's retry_after) answer it plus the governor's jitter (pcalc governor jitter).

CustosSweepAfter.description: The seconds after which a QUEUED ticket is taken for one whose job was lost: POLL of the account's own QUEUED ticket at least this old (by its created time) pushes the job custosLand for it again, deduplicated; the job's conditional claim lands each ticket once.

CustosMaxRequestBytes.description: The most bytes the parameter records may carry (the Calculator's reader bound, 1 MiB); a request past it is refused before a ticket is written (GA1).

CustosLockLease.description: The seconds a lock granted by PETITION lasts; a lock past its expiry is free to the next PETITION, and a PUSH needs the lock within it.

CustosAgentStop.description: The Operator's AGENT STOP: true refuses every agent request at admission (the governor's switch, read into the metered state).

CustosGovernorOff.description: GOVERNOR OFF: true skips the rate at admission and keeps the switches and the slots (the governor's switch, read into the metered state).

CustosSeatLockSeconds.description: The seconds the landing job waits for an account's seat lock (the database's named lock custos-seat:<account>), under which the admission reads the account's seats, asks the governor and writes its charge, so two jobs never both spend the account's last seat. A lock not obtained in this time answers the ticket ADMISSION with SLOT RETRY-AFTER plus the governor's jitter and charges nothing.

CustosSuspended.description: The accounts SUSPENDED under CR6 or CR11; each one's requests are refused at admission.

CustosTps.description: The TPS field the landing job writes into every landed record: the specification's version. Empty: no PUSH lands.

CustosDIs.description: The D_IS field the landing job writes into every landed record, 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Empty: no PUSH lands.

CustosJobContext.description: The landing job's context: min_address_space, the KiB of address space the job needs (the measured need); a job given less refuses with JOB CONTEXT and never starts the Calculator. 0 checks nothing.

CustosBatch.description: The batch jobs' frame: pressure, the pressure level the frame passes to `governor admit` (CLEAR, BUSY, STRAINED or OVERLOADED) until the level is metered; lane 5 is admitted at CLEAR and BUSY and refused at the others, the run ending DEFERRED; defer_wait, the seconds answered as the retry-after when the governor gives none.

CustosRestrictedNamespace.description: The number of the restricted namespace Restricted:, as the namespaces of this file register it, with no talk namespace. The permission hook reads a title in it through this number; a title MediaWiki gives the next number (unregistered, with no name) is refused for every action. Changed only with the namespaces registered here.

CustosRoles.description: The group of each role's accounts: the Declarer's (pma-declarer), the Operator's (pma-operator), the certified agent's (pma-agent), the Contributor's (pma-contributor, asked the Contributor's cells, which are the Public's). The permission hook admits a read of a restricted page by an account in the Declarer's or the Operator's group only; a role missing admits no one, and the agent role missing or empty refuses every request on a governed page (fail closed).

CustosMeterSample.description: The governor's meter samples anonymous reads 1 in this many, each kept row weighted by it; an account's governed request is always metered (custos_meter).

CustosPreGateFile.description: The PRE-GATE's deny list, which the budget roll-up (the job custosBudget) writes whole by a temporary file and a rename, and custos/pregate.php reads before MediaWiki loads (the Operator wires it by auto_prepend_file and names the same path there). Empty: no list is written.
